name: Magellanic Bridge, quasar field ESO 31-8 (Hubble)
blurb: A field in the Magellanic Bridge, toward the background source ESO 31-8, seen by Hubble.
label: mcbridgeqso4-hubble
story: The stars scattered here belong to the Magellanic Bridge, tidal debris strung between the Large and Small Magellanic Clouds. Hubble looked twice, measuring how the stars drift against a distant background source to test whether the two Clouds collided head-on.

claims.text: The field is one of the Magellanic Bridge proper-motion fields, centered on a background source listed as a QSO, alternate name ESO31-8
The quasar targets are background QSOs in the Magellanic Bridge
The Bridge holds tidal debris between the LMC and SMC; the program tests whether it comes from a recent direct-hit collision
Hubble imaged the field twice (first and second epochs), using quasars as stationary reference sources to measure star motions
First-epoch observation of the same field
